info.name: Retrieving the Storybook : Kong Ji and Pat Ji

descriptions.notStarted: I heard the Helios Tower Library has been ruined. I need to go check it out...
descriptions.inProgress: Wiz the Librarian seemed very concerned about the mix-up of the storybook on Kong Ji and Pat Ji, and he wished to get the story straight and find the storybook that actually does present the story in the right order.
descriptions.completed: Through the request from Wiz the Librarian, I have managed to straighten out the story of Kong Ji and Pat Ji and acquired the fixed storybook, afterwhich I headed back to Wiz and gave him the book.
